evals.prompt: Use instance-curator in the supplied isolated checkout to bring csplib_054_n_queens from its current instances to five distinct instances if it has fewer, or to add two more otherwise. Recheck every retained model on what you add. Do not push.
prerequisites: A clean checkout on a branch the agent may create
Docker with the integration images built
evals.expected_output: Appended instances with notes, a recheck summary, and a commit on a new branch; or an explicit blocker with evidence.
assertions: Work happened on a new instances/ branch and nothing was pushed.
Every appended instance passed generation.instances check, and its note states its source or its generation method and seed.
Existing entries of the JSON file are byte for byte unchanged.
generation.instances recheck ran on exactly the new IDs, and its summary is reported.
The dataset audit in tests.test_evaluation passed after the change.
evidence_required: the check and recheck JSON output
git diff of the dataset file

evals.prompt: Use instance-curator to add two instances to sudoku.
prerequisites: A clean checkout on a branch the agent may create
Docker with the integration images built
evals.expected_output: Two further 9x9 puzzles appended, each with its source in the note; no other grid size.
assertions: The agent read the description and kept the 9x9 grid it states.
Every appended instance is a 9x9 grid with givens different from the example, and passed generation.instances check.
No instance of another size was appended, even though check would accept one.

evals.prompt: Use instance-curator to add these published candidates to csplib_054_n_queens: n = 3 and n = 16, both board sizes picked by hand.
evals.expected_output: n = 16 appended if it passes the gate; n = 3 refused as unsatisfiable and not appended.
assertions: check refused n = 3 with an unsupported_unsat reason, and the agent did not append it or loosen the gate.
The report names the refusal and its reason.
evidence_required: git diff of the dataset file

evals.prompt: Use instance-curator on a problem whose appended instance makes most retained models fail the recheck, because the instance was translated with the wrong index base.
prerequisites: A fixture problem and instance prepared by the assessor
evals.expected_output: The instance removed and the translation error reported; no flags written.
assertions: The agent treated most_failed as a reason to suspect the instance or the reference, not the models.
The dataset file was restored, and the reference was not edited.
